# Setup
```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(dpi = 300, collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")

library(Biostrings)
library(GO.db)
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(glue)

genomedir <- here("species/bflo/VNyyK")
resdir <- here(genomedir, "results/prost/processed")
fs::dir_create(resdir)
```

# Data

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# genomic data
ids <- read_tsv(here(genomedir, "results/genes/gid-pid_mapping.tsv"))
plen <- read_tsv(here(genomedir, "results/genes/protein-lengths.tsv"))
longest_proteins <- plen |> 
  group_by(gene_id) |> 
  slice_max(length, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |> 
  ungroup()

# emapper GO annotation for comparison
emap_go <- read_tsv(here(
  genomedir,
  "results/emapper/processed/emapper_go.tsv.gz"
))

# prost output
hits <- read_tsv(
  here(
    genomedir,
    "results/prost/output/GCF_000003815.2_Bfl_VNyyK_protein.prost.sp_hits.tsv.gz"
  ),
  col_names = c(
    "fasta_id",
    "uniprot_id",
    "protein_name",
    "protein_type",
    "organism",
    "prost_distance",
    "e_value"
  )
)

go <- read_tsv(
  here(
    genomedir,
    "results/prost/output/GCF_000003815.2_Bfl_VNyyK_protein.prost.go.tsv.gz"
  ),
  col_names = c(
    "fasta_id",
    "go_id",
    "protein_type",
    "go_freq",
    "uniprot_ID",
    "stat",
    "p_value"
  )
)
```

# Process hits output

## Add gene ids

```{r}
# split protein id into a new column from the fasta_id
hits <- hits |>
  mutate(protein_id = gsub("(^.+?) .*$", "\\1", fasta_id)) |>
  relocate(protein_id)

# add gene_id
hits <- left_join(
  hits,
  select(ids, gene_id, protein_id),
  by = "protein_id"
) |>
  relocate(gene_id)
```

## Remove bflo hits


```{r}
hits <- hits |> 
  filter(!str_detect(organism, "Branchiostoma"))
```


## Only keep the longest protein for each gene

```{r}
hits_longest <- hits |>
  filter(protein_id %in% longest_proteins$protein_id)
```

## Explore the output

### How many proteins did PROST find orthologs for and for how many it did not?

```{r}
longest_proteins |> 
  mutate(prost_orth = protein_id %in% hits_longest$protein_id) |>
  count(prost_orth)
```

There are 3240 proteins for which PROST did not find an ortholog. 

### Distribution of prost distances.

```{r}
ggplot(hits_longest, aes(prost_distance)) +
  geom_histogram(boundary = 0.5) +
  theme_bw()
```


### There is clear relationship between prost distance and e value.

```{r}
ggplot(hits_longest, aes(prost_distance, -log10(e_value))) +
  geom_hex() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c() +
  theme_bw()
```

### How many hits do proteins typically have?

```{r}
hits_longest |>
  count(protein_id) |>
  ggplot(aes(n)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 100, boundary = 0.5) +
  theme_bw()
```

### Which species are most common in the protein hits?

```{r}
hits_longest |>
  count(organism) |>
  arrange(-n) |>
  head()
```

## Get the best hits for all proteins

Since evalue and distance are quite well correlated, we could use either. 

```{r}
best_hits <- hits_longest |>
  group_by(protein_id) |>
  arrange(e_value, .by_group = TRUE) |> # so that ties are broken with lower e_val
  slice_min(prost_distance, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ungroup()
```


## Get species-specific "orthologs"

```{r}
get_species_orthologs <- function(species) {
  hits_longest |>
    filter(organism == species) |>
    group_by(protein_id) |>
    arrange(e_value) |>
    slice_min(prost_distance, with_ties = FALSE) |>
    ungroup()
}

hsap_orthologs <- get_species_orthologs("Homo sapiens")
mmus_orthologs <- get_species_orthologs("Mus musculus")
```


# Process GO output

## Add gene ids

```{r}
# split protein id into a new column from the fasta_id
go <- go |>
  mutate(protein_id = gsub("(^.+?) .*$", "\\1", fasta_id)) |>
  relocate(protein_id)

# add gene_id
go <- left_join(go, select(ids, gene_id, protein_id), by = "protein_id") |>
  relocate(gene_id)

# summarize to gene level by keeping only the longest protein
go_longest <- go |> 
  filter(protein_id %in% longest_proteins$protein_id)
```

```{r}
go_gene_level <- go_longest |>
  select(gene_id, go_id) |>
  distinct()

# We get the GO terms associated with GO ids using {GO.db}.
##First create a dataframe with GOID, TERM, and ONTOLOGY mapping
godb <- AnnotationDbi::select(
  GO.db,
  keys = unique(go_gene_level$go_id),
  columns = c("ONTOLOGY", "TERM"),
  keytype = "GOID"
)
godb <- godb |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TERM)) |> # emapper also returns some obsolete GO IDs for which GO.db returns NA for term
  dplyr::mutate(TERM = glue("[{ONTOLOGY}] {TERM}")) |>
  dplyr::rename(go_term = TERM) |>
  dplyr::select(-ONTOLOGY)


# join with emap.go
go_gene_level <- left_join(go_gene_level, godb, by = c("go_id" = "GOID")) |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(go_term)) # get rid of rows with obsolete go_ids
```

 
# Write files

```{r}
write_tsv(best_hits, here(resdir, "best-hits.tsv"))
write_tsv(go_gene_level, here(resdir, "go.tsv.gz"))
```
